metadata.question: Was vegetation greenness (NDVI) within a 40 km raidus around Moroto, Uganda during August 2023 lower than its average for August between 1991 and 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: Moroto, Uganda (approximately 1.65°N, 34.67°E) - Compare two periods: - August 2023 (recent) - August 1991-2010 (historical average) - Use Landsat data (covers 1991 onwards) - 40 km radius buffer around Moroto 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Cloud mask: Yes, remove clouds to get valid vegetation data - Use QA_PIXEL band for Landsat to mask clouds - Calculate NDVI from (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid Zero (A/B): NDVI values are calculated correctly (range -1 to 1) - Null/Error (C3): NDVI is NaN, None, or out of valid range - C1: If collection is empty for either period - C2: If all pixels are masked (cloud cover too high) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Moroto, Uganda location and 40 km radius const morotoCoords = [34.67, 1.65]; // [lon, lat] const morotoPoint = ee.Geometry.Point(morotoCoords); const buffer40km = morotoPoint.buffer(40000); // 40 km radius // 2. Helper function to calculate NDVI and mask clouds function getNDVICollection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer40km) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(function(img) { // Cloud masking using QA_PIXEL var cloudMask = img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0) .and(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(64).eq(0)); // Calculate NDVI: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) var ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']) .updateMask(cloudMask); return ndvi; }); } // 3. Get August 2023 data const aug2023Col = getNDVICollection('2023-08-01', '2023-08-31'); const aug2023Size = await aug2023Col.size().getInfo(); if (aug2023Size === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 7 const aug2023ColL7 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer40km) .filterDate('2023-08-01', '2023-08-31') .map(function(img) { var cloudMask = img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(32).eq(0) .and(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(64).eq(0)); var ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).updateMask(cloudMask); return ndvi; }); const fallbackSize = await aug2023ColL7.size().getInfo(); if (fallbackSize === 0) { print('August 2023 Images: 0'); print('C1'); return; } } // 4. Get historical August data (1991-2010) const historicalCol = getNDVICollection('1991-08-01', '2010-08-31'); const historicalSize = await historicalCol.size().getInfo(); if (historicalSize === 0) { print('Historical August (1991-2010) Images: 0'); print('C1'); return; } print(`August 2023 Images: ${aug2023Size}`); print(`August 1991-2010 Images: ${historicalSize}`); // 5. Calculate mean NDVI for August 2023 const aug2023Mean = aug2023Col.mean(); const aug2023Stats = await aug2023Mean .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), buffer40km, 1000, null, null, false, 1e9 ).getInfo(); const ndvi2023 = aug2023Stats.nd ? aug2023Stats.nd : null; const count2023 = aug2023Stats['count'] ? aug2023Stats['count'] : 0; if (!ndvi2023 || isNaN(ndvi2023) || count2023 === 0) { print(`August 2023: No valid pixels (Count: ${count2023})`); print('C2'); return; } // 6. Calculate mean NDVI for historical period const historicalMean = historicalCol.mean(); const historicalStats = await historicalMean .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), buffer40km, 1000, null, null, false, 1e9 ).getInfo(); const ndviHistorical = historicalStats.nd ? historicalStats.nd : null; const countHistorical = historicalStats['count'] ? historicalStats['count'] : 0; if (!ndviHistorical || isNaN(ndviHistorical) || countHistorical === 0) { print(`August 1991-2010: No valid pixels (Count: ${countHistorical})`); print('C2'); return; } // 7. Validate NDVI ranges (-1 to 1) if (ndvi2023 < -1 || ndvi2023 > 1 || ndviHistorical < -1 || ndviHistorical > 1) { print(`Invalid NDVI values: 2023=${ndvi2023}, Historical=${ndviHistorical}`); print('C3'); return; } // 8. Final comparison print(`August 2023 NDVI: ${ndvi2023.toFixed(4)} (Pixels: ${Math.round(count2023)})`); print(`August 1991-2010 NDVI: ${ndviHistorical.toFixed(4)} (Pixels: ${Math.round(countHistorical)})`); print(`Difference: ${(ndvi2023 - ndviHistorical).toFixed(4)}`); if (ndvi2023 < ndviHistorical) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
